messages.cli.metrics.bad_day: {option} takes a day as yyyy-mm-dd, not "{value}".
messages.cli.metrics.plan.window: --plan reads a plan over its whole life: leave out --since and --until.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.not_a_plan: {id} is no plan quest: it delivers {deliverable}, not sub-quests. --plan takes a quest whose kind delivers sub-quests.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.none: No sub-quest yet: the plan is not delivered.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.line.parts: Sub-quests: {parts}, {begun} of them begun; {outside} changed files outside their scope; memos filed: {memos}.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.line.estimate: Estimate: {estimate} tokens; first runs: {first_run} tokens ({ratio} of the estimate of the parts begun); every session of the parts: {tokens} tokens; the plan quest itself: {plan} tokens.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.limit.parts: The parts are the sub-quests the mage drafted, children of the plan or of another part; the merge quest and the blind trial's part are the Steward's, the plan never sized them, so they are left out.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.limit.first_run: A part's first run is every session of its assignee's first attempt, the mana's pauses included: what its estimate sized. Its tokens count every session, judges and rework included.
messages.cli.metrics.plan.limit.written: Files edited come from the hook's lines (agent.tool, kind write): an edit made through a shell is not seen. Outside the scope is what the part's last submit changed outside it, the territory's shared paths aside; — before its first submit.
messages.cli.metrics.check_modes.measure: Minutes: full/narrow use start-to-end elapsed time; patrol and merged-quest machine cost sum check durations. Full runs per day include every full check.end and patrol.ran, including errors. Costs include the quest's checks before the window; red intervals keep their observed endpoints. p90 uses nearest rank.

messages.cli.metrics.never_green: no patrol found it green before
messages.cli.metrics.limit.rule: Rework is every character session beyond one assignee and one verifier per quest; sessions stopped by mana and machine runs are not counted.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.check: A check that went red on files Elvaria wrote into the worktree shows as output: the verdict does not say whose file failed.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.crash: A verifier crash covers both a dead CLI and an invalid verdict.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.cancelled: cancelled covers both a release when the Steward restarts and a cancel by the owner.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.day: A timestamp belongs to the day it is written in, in the zone of the kingdom; owner commands are counted by their command.applied line: the kind from the line (since PS-01b) or from inbox/done, the quest from inbox/done.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.set_aside: Checks set aside for their environment are counted only on check.end lines written since PS-01b; before, they show as failed checks.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.reads: A read is an agent.tool line of kind read that names a path; a line with no session counts in the total only. Lines written before PS-21 still count Glob, Grep and LS (agy: grep_search, find_by_name, list_dir) as reads; since PS-21 they are searches.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.first_edits: Calls before the first edit count the agent.tool lines of each assignee session, the apprentice's included; the role comes from the attempt log, so the extra sessions inside a run, which it does not name, are left out.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.prompts: Prompt sizes are in characters, trimmed, from the load trace of a session's opening line (since PS-01b); a session that followed the first in a run has none.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.status_times: Time in a status runs from the line that put a quest there to the one that moved it on, counted on the day it ended; a quest still there is not counted. Review without a judge includes its machine checks.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.advice: The advice "owner" advises nothing and stays out of the rate; merge and new_quest are followed when you had a quest do the work (handled), shelve when you shelved the memo. Only memos you decided count, not the triage's.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.after_wrap_up: After the reminder counts only assignee sessions with an agent.session.wrap_up line (the Steward writes the reminder when a session passes soft_pct) and an agent.session.end line; a session still running is not counted, and a session counts on the day of its reminder. Cut is killed, max_turns or budget: the breaker, the CLI's own ceiling, or the Steward stopping the session for another reason (mana ran out, the owner stopped it); a session that ended in an error counts only as reminded. Tokens after count only for a reminder on the token measure whose end line has a usage. The table does not say whether the hook's reminder reached the model (question (f)).
messages.cli.metrics.title.lessons: Lessons in the scriptures: loads, helped, missed and effect
messages.cli.metrics.title.fail_kinds: Fail kinds over time (failed runs of judged runs, per bucket of {size})
messages.cli.metrics.title.repeats: Repeated failures among the last {window} judged runs (from {min} verdicts of one kind)
messages.cli.metrics.lessons.none: No session has written a per-line load trace yet (load_trace.lessons, since PS-12), so there is no lesson to count.
messages.cli.metrics.fail_kinds.none: No run has been judged yet, or none failed.
messages.cli.metrics.repeats.none: No failure repeats: no kind has {min} verdicts among the last {window} judged runs.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.lessons: The lessons table counts per run of the assignee, taking the first opening line of the run, so a later or a repeated session adds nothing; only runs with a per-line load trace (since PS-12) are in it. Helped and missed need the line to name the kind of failure it cures; a line deleted from the scripture file keeps its counts and loses its sentence. The effect sets the runs in the line's scope before its first load against the runs that carried it. The ledger does not record the OS of a run, so a scope key os filters nothing here; a line only a judge reads has no assignee run to measure, so its effect is empty.
messages.cli.metrics.limit.raised: Raised counts the reminded sessions that had an agent.session.usage line with a higher limit than the session's previous one on the same gauge: the owner raised the budget while the session ran.
